name: Write.as
description: Publish Markdown to Write.as, update articles and query publication status.
author: Typora Team

siteUrl.title: Site
siteUrl.description: HTTPS API server. Publishing state is stored separately for each account and site.

username.title: User name
username.description: Your primary account, the first blog you created.

password.title: Password
password.description: Used once over HTTPS to sign in to this site, then discarded. Typora keeps only the access token it gets back, as described below, never in your documents or settings. Sign Out of Write.as deletes it. Leave empty to stay signed in.

collection.title: Blog alias
collection.description: Required: the name in your blog's address, such as my-blog in write.as/my-blog. Not its title.
